text: I am exercising my right under the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ), specifically under 15 U.S.C. 1681b, to request that you exclude my information from any reports or disclosures provided by ChexSystems. Additionally, I would like to bring to your attention the fact that, to the best of my knowledge, there has been no formal written instruction from me, the consumer, authorizing the furnishing or sharing of my information with ChexSystems. As such, I am concerned about the inclusion of my information in any reports or disclosures provided by ChexSystems without explicit consent. I kindly request that you promptly process this opt-out request and confirm in writing that my information will no longer be included in any reports or disclosures provided by ChexSystems.
